decision.reason: The dizzy cue is semantically broad, and DBP records overlapping Malaysian pening and pusing senses including headache, spinning, and confusion (https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pening and https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=259120&keyword=pusing). The proposed pusing/pening national contrast is unresolved; hold for a narrower cue and usage evidence.
